title: Stable amplitude blowup for a supercritical defocusing torus equation
exact_target: Does the defocusing power NLS i $partial_t$ u+Delta $u-|u|^{p-1}u=0$ on $T^12$ admit an odd $p\geq 3$, finite integer $k>8$ and a nonempty open set in $H^k$ such that every initial datum in that set has finite-time classical $H^k$ blowup? Require a point $x_*$ and $c_0>0$ with $(T-t)^(1/(p-1))|u(t,x_*)|\to c_0$.
